status: registered before any AlphaEarth tile is downloaded or scored
direction: Beat AlphaEarth (user, 2026-09-27). Hypothesis from its public design: annual embeddings (one per calendar year) dilute transient events such as floods, which recede in days-weeks; per-observation OlmoEarth embeddings do not. 2609.25731 itself reports annual-summary limits (late-season fires, no within-season mapping) and never compared per-date embeddings.

data.events: KuroSiwo test split (10 events, disjoint from train), restricted to flood years 2018+ so that both year Y and Y-1 exist in AlphaEarth (2017-2025)
data.tiles: flood tiles (flood >= 2% of valid px), permanent-water-only tiles (flood 0, permanent water >= 5%), dry tiles (no water, >= 90% valid); from kurosiwo_s1_cache mask_u8/valid_u8 (192x192 centre crop, 10 m)
data.alphaearth: Satellite Embedding V1 annual, anonymous mirror https://data.source.coop/tge-labs/aef/v1/annual/ (CC-BY 4.0, 'The AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset is produced by Google and Google DeepMind'), window 192x192 px around the KuroSiwo tile centroid, years Y (flood year) and Y-1; int8 dequantised as (v/127.5)^2*sign(v)
data.olmoearth: kurosiwo_s1_cache/single_fp16 (3,768,48,48): pre_1, pre_2, post, OlmoEarth v1 Base, S1 VV/VH (existing cache)
data.sar_reference: raw S1 VV log-ratio post vs pre_2 from kurosiwo_npy raw_f32 (classic label-free flood change), reported as reference, not a competitor for the primary verdict

scores_label_free.aef: per pixel 1 - cos(e_Y, e_Y-1), mean-pooled to the 48x48 grid (4x4 px = 40 m)
scores_label_free.olmoearth: per token 1 - cos(post, pre_2) on the 48x48 grid
scores_label_free.no_training: no labels, no fitting; thresholds are never tuned, only rank metrics are used

metrics.T1_tile_detection: AUC of tile-mean change: flood tiles vs (dry + permanent-water-only) tiles; also flood vs permanent-water-only alone
metrics.T2_localisation: within flood tiles, token-level AUC of change score for tokens with flood fraction >= 0.5 vs tokens with flood fraction 0 (pooled across tiles), and the per-tile mean of token AUCs
metrics.ci: 95% event-clustered bootstrap (resample events, 2000) of OlmoEarth - AEF differences

primary_verdict.olmoearth_beats_aef: OlmoEarth - AEF >= 0.05 AUC on BOTH T1 (flood vs dry+perm) and T2 (pooled token AUC), each with event-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
primary_verdict.invalid: fewer than 3 events or fewer than 100 flood tiles with both AEF years available; or AEF windows failing georeference checks (> 10% of tiles with all-masked pixels)

secondary: AEF with year Y+1 instead of Y-1 as the 'after' layer
flood month (late-year events) vs AEF gap
what_this_does_not_show: AlphaEarth's quality on its own benchmark tasks
anything about landslides or fires (separate A2/A3)
meaningfulness_rule: config/meaningfulness_rule_amendment_20260927.json (+0.05); here the strongest baseline is AlphaEarth annual embeddings (the target named by the user)
